name: Cam4 Downloader
headline: TikTok Video Downloader: Download MP4s
short_description: TikTok Video Downloader is a browser extension for users who want a smoother way to save TikTok videos for offline viewing. It detects supported video sources from active pages and exports MP4 files without the need for manual workarounds.
author: serpdownloaders

sections.overview:
TikTok Video Downloader is a browser extension that lets you save supported TikTok videos as MP4 files directly from your browser—no third-party sites, no watermarks, no screen recordings. It works on feed pages, user profiles, hashtag pages, music pages, and single video pages, detecting video sources automatically and handling TikTok's CDN authentication for reliable downloads. The extension adds download overlays to every video while you browse, and you can toggle them on or off from the popup. Built for creators, archivists, and casual users who want a cleaner offline workflow instead of relying on low-quality captures or watermarked download services.
Download TikTok videos from watch pages
Save videos from user profiles
Export videos for offline editing
Avoid manual source tracing for downloads
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/serpdownloaders/skills --skill tiktok-video-downloader`
`git clone https://github.com/serpdownloaders/tiktok-video-downloader`
sections.usage:
```
Extract and download the highest quality MP4 video from [TIKTOK_VIDEO_URL]. Provide a direct download link and filename in the format 'TikTok_[VIDEO_ID].mp4'. Only return the download link and filename—no additional text.
```
Copy

```
# Download Ready

**Video ID:** 7382914567890123456
**Filename:** TikTok_7382914567890123456.mp4

📥 [Download MP4](https://cdn.tiktok.com/v1/tiktok_7382914567890123456.mp4)
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
